lede: Wat Pang Mu accounts for 77 catalogued manuscripts, 2 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Mae Hong Son (99% of the corpus for this temple), ahead of Mueang District. Nearly all (96%) are written in Shan · อักษรไทใหญ่ script. By support it leans to mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (97%) over khoi paper · กระดาษข่อย (1%). Dated witnesses run 1881–1972 CE (42 of 77 carry a date).
